captions.text: Your mission: fly to Mars and build an outpost
Earth and Mars both circle the Sun; Mars is slower
First the ship circles Earth in a parking orbit
Trans-Mars injection: one big burn to escape Earth
It leaves when Mars is about 44 degrees ahead
Engine off: half an orbit around the Sun...
A braking burn lets Mars capture the ship in orbit
Launch windows to Mars come every 26 months
Build a working outpost before the next ships arrive
